Method of Attack: UEFI rootkit installed within SPI flash storage on motherboard, persistent malware; modular multi-stage malware framework with downloaders and loaders to deploy malicious payloads
Discoverer: Kaspersky researchers Mark Lechtik and Igor Kuznetsov
Impacted Systems: Computers of NGOs and diplomatic entities from Africa, Asia, and Europe
Attack Vector: Possibly physical access with dedicated update tool via USB flash drive boot
Remote deployment by compromising BIOS update authentication after exploiting BIOS vulnerabilities
SFX archives pretending to be documents related to North Korea
